title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 7: fire from heaven, the great dedication feast and Yahweh's answer to Solomon by night.

questions.text: What came down from heaven when Solomon had finished praying?
questions.explanation: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices.

answers.text: Hail
Fire
Manna
Rain

questions.text: Why could the priests not enter Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: The priests could not enter because Yahweh's glory filled Yahweh's house.

answers.text: The doors had not yet been hung
The king had forbidden it
They had not yet purified themselves
Yahweh's glory filled the house

questions.text: What did the people say as they worshiped with their faces to the ground?
questions.explanation: The people gave thanks to Yahweh, saying, "For he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever."

answers.text: "For he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever."
"Holy, holy, holy is Yahweh; the whole earth is full of him."
"Yahweh is a man of war; Yahweh is his name."
"Let the king live forever, and his house be blessed."

questions.text: How many head of cattle did King Solomon offer as a sacrifice?
questions.explanation: King Solomon offered twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep.

answers.text: Two thousand two hundred
Seven thousand
Twenty-two thousand
Forty thousand

questions.text: Why did Solomon make the middle of the court holy for the offerings?
questions.explanation: He did so because the bronze altar he had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering and the fat.

answers.text: The bronze altar had been defiled by the people
The bronze altar was not able to receive all the offerings
The priests refused to use the bronze altar
The Levites asked Solomon for a second altar

questions.text: From where to where did the great assembly come for the seven-day feast?
questions.explanation: All Israel came, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.

answers.text: From the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt
From the city of Dan to the city of Beersheba
From the river Jordan to the shore of the great sea
From the gates of Damascus to the walls of Gaza

questions.text: On which day did Solomon send the people away to their tents?
questions.explanation: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people away, joyful and glad of heart.

answers.text: The first day of the first month
The fifteenth day of the second month
The twenty-third day of the seventh month
The tenth day of the seventh month

questions.text: If God's people humble themselves, pray, seek his face and turn from their wicked ways, what does God promise?
questions.explanation: God promises to hear from heaven, forgive their sin and heal their land.

answers.text: To give them gold, silver and many cattle
To make Solomon king over all the earth
To send a prophet to every city
To hear from heaven, forgive their sin and heal their land

questions.text: If they served other gods, what did God say he would make of this house among all peoples?
questions.explanation: God said he would cast the house out of his sight and make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

answers.text: A house of prayer for the nations
A proverb and a byword
A storehouse for treasure
A place of refuge

questions.text: According to the answer in verse 22, why would Yahweh bring all this evil on them?
questions.explanation: They would answer that it was because the people abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and served other gods.

answers.text: Because they abandoned Yahweh and served other gods
Because Solomon built the house too high
Because they did not pay tribute to Egypt
Because the priests forgot the feast days
